<?php
// E2E probe (test only): runs a gateway request and some log calls with sentinel customer/payment values,
// then returns what ended up in the WooCommerce log file. HTTP is short-circuited; nothing leaves the machine.
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e_probe'] ) ) { return; }
	add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function () {
		return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&transactionid=TXN-777&authcode=AUTH1&avsresponse=Y&cvvresponse=M&customer_vault_id=SENTINEL-VAULT-123&first_name=SentinelFirst&email=sentinel%40example.test', 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	} );
	$client = new \Cardz3n_Gateway\Api_Client();
	$client->post( array(
		'type'              => 'sale',
		'amount'            => '12.34',
		'currency'          => 'USD',
		'orderid'           => '7777',
		'payment'           => 'creditcard',
		'payment_token'     => 'SENTINEL-TOKEN-ABC',
		'customer_vault_id' => 'SENTINEL-VAULT-123',
		'first_name'        => 'SentinelFirst',
		'last_name'         => 'SentinelLast',
		'email'             => 'sentinel@example.test',
		'phone'             => '+1-555-0100',
		'address1'          => '99 Sentinel Road',
		'city'              => 'Sentinelville',
		'zip'               => '99999',
	) );
	// Other log paths that take free-form context.
	\Cardz3n_Gateway\Logger::info( 'probe context', array( 'payment_token' => 'SENTINEL-TOKEN-ABC', 'vault_id' => 'SENTINEL-VAULT-123', 'billing_email' => 'sentinel@example.test', 'billing_phone' => '+1-555-0100', 'billing_address_1' => '99 Sentinel Road', 'order_id' => 7777 ) );
	$log = '';
	foreach ( (array) glob( trailingslashit( WC_LOG_DIR ) . 'cardz3n-gateway*.log' ) as $f ) { $log .= (string) file_get_contents( $f ); }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	echo wp_json_encode( array( 'log' => $log, 'length' => strlen( $log ) ) );
	exit;
}, 20 );
